spec_html_en: Write class StockTicker with subscribe(self, callback), unsubscribe(self, callback) and notify(self, price). subscribe adds a callback. unsubscribe removes it if present, doing nothing if it was never subscribed. notify calls every currently subscribed callback with price, in subscription order.
test:
def test_subscriber_receives_notifications():
    received = []
    ticker = StockTicker()
    ticker.subscribe(lambda price: received.append(price))
    ticker.notify(100)
    assert received == [100], 'a subscribed callback must receive the notified price'

def test_unsubscribed_callback_stops_receiving():
    received = []
    def watcher(price):
        received.append(price)
    ticker = StockTicker()
    ticker.subscribe(watcher)
    ticker.notify(100)
    ticker.unsubscribe(watcher)
    ticker.notify(200)
    assert received == [100], 'after unsubscribe, the callback must not receive further notifications'

def test_unsubscribing_unknown_callback_is_a_no_op():
    ticker = StockTicker()
    def never_subscribed(price):
        pass
    ticker.unsubscribe(never_subscribed)
    ticker.notify(50)
